messages.text:
"Build a lightweight one-tap mobile game as a single HTML file.

Concept: a ball bounces upward through gaps in rotating rings. Tap to flip direction and dodge obstacles.

Requirements:
- Portrait layout, fills the screen, works on touch (no keyboard)
- One-tap controls, understandable in 5 seconds with no tutorial
- Canvas-based, smooth 60fps, under 200 KB total
- No external images, fonts, or libraries; draw everything with code
- Score counter, best score saved in localStorage
- Game over screen with a big \"Play again\" button
- Difficulty ramps up gradually
- Simple sound effects using the Web Audio API, with a mute button
- Bold, minimal look: 3-4 colors, dark background
- Pauses automatically when the tab loses focus

Give me the complete code in one file and a one-line description of how to play. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
